tuesday_round.name: Tuesday
tuesday_round.description: Mrs Allen says the nurse did the Waters on a Tuesday after her, over Castle Bridge to {place:reed_end}, where the Lovedays cut reed. Mrs Allen would like to know whether Mrs Loveday has seen her since. She does not say since when.
tuesday_round.completion: Mrs Loveday had seen her, on a Tuesday in the spring, and not since. She had kept something of the nurse's back for her, and it is still there.
